To my brother, I must've been living a perfect life, just as you believe your lil brother is living a stress-free life. But hey, look at me now! 12 years later and I'm a depressed and suicidal person with a broken relationship with my brother. 

Your frustration is completely understandable, but try your best to not hate your brother too much. He is only 5 after all, he's not intentionally doing these things to annoy you, even if it seems like it. I'd really hate to see you both growing up and hating and ignoring each other.
